title: Red Sorceress Magic Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of the same female character with long black hair in a red outfit, demonstrating progressive stages of casting a spell. The sequence shows her summoning red electrical energy in her hands, raising her arms to channel intense power with bright red lightning effects, then unleashing a powerful red energy explosion, and finally standing with residual red smoke and sparks emanating from her hands.
prompt: A four-panel sequence showing the same female character with long flowing black hair in a high ponytail, wearing a red corset dress with black lace-up boots and red cape. She has pale skin and red fingerless gloves. First pose shows her summoning red electrical energy between her hands, second pose has both arms raised high channeling intense red lightning, third pose shows her unleashing a powerful red energy explosion with bright sparks and chains, final pose shows her standing confidently with residual red smoke and sparks coming from her hands. Dark grey background, dynamic action, fantasy style, detailed digital painting.
